path_today_lead: One next action, and a clear view of where you stand.
path_path_lead: Keys open one at a time. A mastered scale opens the next one, never speed.
path_start_lead: Your answer only decides how many keys are open at once. You can change it later: it never closes a key you have already opened and never erases an attempt.
path_start_never_title: I have never typed without looking
path_start_never_body: I start from the home row anchors and the space bar, one key at a time.
path_start_home_body: My fingers already find the home row, so it is open from the start.
path_start_accuracy_body: Every letter is open; digits and punctuation open through scales.
path_start_change_note: Changing it never erases attempts and never closes an open key. It can only open more.
path_next_lowerTempo: Your accuracy was {accuracy}%, below the {floor}% floor. Slow down and repeat this scale.
path_next_weakTransition: The move {from} to {to} is your weakest ({confidence}% confidence). Drill it now.
path_next_evenRhythm: Your accuracy is good but your rhythm is uneven ({rhythm}%). Repeat this scale at an even pace.
path_streak_explain: Mastery is {target} consecutive Test attempts at or above {floor}% accuracy. Speed gates nothing. A failed attempt resets the streak to zero, and Practice attempts leave it unchanged.
path_keyboard_summary: {unlocked} of {total} keys unlocked. Next to unlock: {key}.
path_scale_lock_focus: Opens once you master the key {key}
path_start_lower_disabled: This would open fewer keys than you already have
path_review_intro: The keys and transitions that give you the most trouble. This is not the next action — it is a list to look through and choose from yourself.
path_review_not_enough: Not enough observations yet. Confidence is only computed after {samples} keystrokes on an element, and calling something weak on the strength of two sightings is noise, not feedback.
path_review_no_drill: no drill of its own yet
path_review_threshold: A transition is only named after {samples} observations.
path_words_lead: Every word is made only of keys you have already opened. Each new key brings new words.
path_words_locked: Words open together with the home row. Keys still missing: {keys}.
path_words_error: The dictionary did not load. Reload the page to try again.
path_words_keys_ahead: {count} more keys ahead: each one opens its own words.
path_words_lock_thin: Your open keys do not make enough words yet
path_words_lock_weak: Appears once your attempts show your weak keys
path_words_goal_first: The home row in real words: {keys}. Every finger stays on its own key.
path_words_goal_short: Words of up to 4 letters: fingers return to the home row after each one.
path_words_goal_medium: Words of 5-7 letters: an even movement with no pause inside a word.
path_words_goal_long: Words of 8 letters or more: a long chain of moves without looking down.
path_words_goal_key: The key “{key}”, {finger}: it is in every word.
path_words_goal_ukLetter: “{key}” is typed by the {finger}. It is a letter of its own and is never replaced by another.
path_words_goal_repeat: The same key twice in a row: the finger presses twice and does not drift.
path_words_goal_sameFinger: One finger moves between rows: only the finger travels, the hand stays put.
path_words_goal_alternation: Hands take turns: while one types, the other is already ready for the next letter.
path_words_goal_apostrophe: An apostrophe inside a word, {finger}. The hand does not leave the home row.
path_words_goal_hyphen: A hyphen between the parts of a word, {finger}.
path_words_goal_capitals: A capital at the start of a word: Shift is held by the opposite pinky.
path_words_goal_weak_none: Words from the keys and moves you find hardest.
path_words_goal_focus_transition: The move “{from}” → “{to}”: first the {fromFinger}, then the {toFinger}.
path_words_goal_focus_key: The key “{key}”, {finger}: it is in every word.
path_words_exercise_locked: These words cannot be typed yet: some of their keys are still locked. Open them on the map.
path_words_unlock_lead: These words are now made only of open keys:
